Around [[3636 BBY]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] sent his sons, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Arcann]] and Prince [[Thexan]] across the galaxy to conduct a series of '''raids''' to test the strength of the two dominant galactic governments: the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The attacks were largely mysterious to the two entities.

After the assassination of Valkorion and the imprisonment of the Galactic War hero, simply known as [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], Arcann launched a full [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
